sentences.text: Hominenteromicrobium is a genus of gut bacteria, with strains of Hominenteromicrobium mulieris isolated from human faecal samples.
The human gut microbiota is described as dominated by obligately anaerobic bacteria, and reported isolates came from a healthy adult volunteer who is a young adult following a vegetarian diet.
A study reported that Hominenteromicrobium mulieris is prevalent in healthy individuals but depleted in ulcerative colitis.
A strain, MH27-2, has been reported to improve disease pathology and accelerate gut healing in mouse colitis models, and MAP 315 was reported safe and well-tolerated with no serious adverse events.

A Hominenteromicrobium strain, YB328, has been reported to be associated with increased dendritic cell infiltration in tumours, and elevated abundance was linked to favourable response to PD-1 blockade therapy.
